# litany

> The linter for modern OCaml.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](pages/index.md): The linter for modern OCaml.

## Guides

- [Selecting rules](pages/guide/selecting-rules.md): Groups, stability, fix promises and the project rules.
- [Configuration](pages/guide/configuration.md): The litany file: what runs, what each rule is told, and which reports are dropped by path.
- [Suppression](pages/guide/suppression.md): Silencing one finding with a reason, and the audits that keep suppressions honest.
- [Fixing](pages/guide/fixing.md): Safe and unsafe fixes, the checks on every write, and where --fix refuses.
- [Build integration](pages/guide/build-integration.md): Findings in your editor through a dune rule, other build systems, the cache and the workers.
- [CI](pages/guide/ci.md): litany on GitHub Actions, and the text, json and github formats.
- [Writing a rule](pages/guide/writing-a-rule.md): A rule is one value in one file, a registry entry and a fixture.
- [A custom binary](pages/guide/custom-binary.md): The rules extended with your own, by recompiling.

## Reference

- [Reference](pages/reference.md)
- [Rules](pages/reference/rules.md): Every rule litany has.
- [dead-code](pages/reference/rules/dead-code.md): exported value unreachable from any root
- [disable-all-warnings](pages/reference/rules/disable-all-warnings.md): a warning attribute disables every warning
- [eta-reducible-forwarding](pages/reference/rules/eta-reducible-forwarding.md): binding that only forwards its arguments
- [ignored-result](pages/reference/rules/ignored-result.md): result or option value is discarded by a wildcard binding
- [invalid-function-comparison](pages/reference/rules/invalid-function-comparison.md): structural comparison with a function operand
- [invalid-hashtable-key](pages/reference/rules/invalid-hashtable-key.md): polymorphic Hashtbl operation on a value proved functional
- [invalid-nan-comparison](pages/reference/rules/invalid-nan-comparison.md): comparison with nan is a compile-time constant
- [manual-boolean-operator](pages/reference/rules/manual-boolean-operator.md): if with one boolean-literal branch spells an operator longhand
- [manual-case-guard](pages/reference/rules/manual-case-guard.md): case body that is immediately an if-then-else
- [manual-eta-lambda](pages/reference/rules/manual-eta-lambda.md): anonymous function that only forwards its parameters
- [manual-format-quoting](pages/reference/rules/manual-format-quoting.md): format literal hand-quotes %s where %S quotes and escapes
- [manual-list-exists](pages/reference/rules/manual-list-exists.md): recursive function that re-implements List.exists
- [manual-list-filter-map](pages/reference/rules/manual-list-filter-map.md): recursive function that re-implements List.filter or filter_map
- [manual-list-fold](pages/reference/rules/manual-list-fold.md): recursive function that re-implements a List fold
- [manual-list-forall](pages/reference/rules/manual-list-forall.md): recursive function that re-implements List.for_all
- [manual-list-map](pages/reference/rules/manual-list-map.md): recursive function that hand-rolls a list map
- [manual-option-bind](pages/reference/rules/manual-option-bind.md): two-case option match that re-implements Option.bind
- [manual-option-map](pages/reference/rules/manual-option-map.md): two-case match that unwraps, transforms, and rewraps an option
- [manual-option-value](pages/reference/rules/manual-option-value.md): two-case match extracting an option's value over a trivial default
- [manual-record-update](pages/reference/rules/manual-record-update.md): record rebuilt field by field from one base
- [manual-result-bind](pages/reference/rules/manual-result-bind.md): two-case result match that re-implements Result.bind
- [manual-result-map](pages/reference/rules/manual-result-map.md): two-case match that transforms one result arm and rebuilds the other
- [manual-temp-dir](pages/reference/rules/manual-temp-dir.md): temp file removed and re-created as a directory
- [manual-tuple-matching](pages/reference/rules/manual-tuple-matching.md): single irrefutable tuple case that could be a let binding
- [missing-final-newline](pages/reference/rules/missing-final-newline.md): file does not end with a newline
- [missing-printer](pages/reference/rules/missing-printer.md): comparable abstract type whose interface exposes no printer
- [needless-and-binding](pages/reference/rules/needless-and-binding.md): let rec binding riding an and-chain it does not need
- [needless-append-empty](pages/reference/rules/needless-append-empty.md): append or concatenation with the neutral element
- [needless-fun-match](pages/reference/rules/needless-fun-match.md): fun-then-match over an otherwise unused final parameter
- [needless-list-length](pages/reference/rules/needless-list-length.md): List.length compared with 0 or 1 to test emptiness
- [needless-list-map-before-concat](pages/reference/rules/needless-list-map-before-concat.md): List.map feeding concatenation builds an intermediate list
- [needless-mutually-recursive-types](pages/reference/rules/needless-mutually-recursive-types.md): and-chained type that is not mutually recursive with its group
- [open-of-ordinary-module](pages/reference/rules/open-of-ordinary-module.md): an open of a module that is not made to be opened
- [outdated-str-module](pages/reference/rules/outdated-str-module.md): reference into the outdated Str module
- [quadratic-list-append](pages/reference/rules/quadratic-list-append.md): list append folded with the accumulator on the left
- [quadratic-string-concat-chain](pages/reference/rules/quadratic-string-concat-chain.md): a chain of three or more (^) segments
- [quadratic-string-concat-fold](pages/reference/rules/quadratic-string-concat-fold.md): string concatenation folded through (^)
- [redundant-bind-return](pages/reference/rules/redundant-bind-return.md): bind into a bare return re-wraps the value unchanged
- [redundant-boolean-comparison](pages/reference/rules/redundant-boolean-comparison.md): comparison with a boolean constant
- [redundant-boolean-operator](pages/reference/rules/redundant-boolean-operator.md): boolean operator with a constant operand
- [redundant-conversion-roundtrip](pages/reference/rules/redundant-conversion-roundtrip.md): conversion immediately undone by its inverse
- [redundant-guard-true](pages/reference/rules/redundant-guard-true.md): when guard that is literally true or false
- [redundant-if-bool](pages/reference/rules/redundant-if-bool.md): if whose both branches are boolean literals restates the condition
- [redundant-list-roundtrip](pages/reference/rules/redundant-list-roundtrip.md): list converted to a sequence and immediately back
- [redundant-match-bool](pages/reference/rules/redundant-match-bool.md): boolean match interrupting an if/else chain
- [redundant-nested-if](pages/reference/rules/redundant-nested-if.md): else-less if directly nested in an else-less if
- [redundant-not-not](pages/reference/rules/redundant-not-not.md): double boolean negation
- [redundant-option-comparison](pages/reference/rules/redundant-option-comparison.md): comparison with None spells an Option predicate
- [redundant-option-roundtrip](pages/reference/rules/redundant-option-roundtrip.md): option converted to a list only to take its head back
- [redundant-return-bind](pages/reference/rules/redundant-return-bind.md): bind of a fresh return wraps a value only to unwrap it
- [restricted-dependency](pages/reference/rules/restricted-dependency.md): reference to a dependency forbidden by workspace policy
- [restricted-export-name](pages/reference/rules/restricted-export-name.md): exported name breaking the configured naming policy
- [restricted-global-mutable-state](pages/reference/rules/restricted-global-mutable-state.md): toplevel mutable state in library code
- [restricted-public-exception](pages/reference/rules/restricted-public-exception.md): exception declared in a public library interface
- [suspicious-ambiguous-constructors](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-ambiguous-constructors.md): constructor that shadows a standard constructor
- [suspicious-catch-all-handler](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-catch-all-handler.md): wildcard exception handler swallows every exception
- [suspicious-duplicate-condition](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-duplicate-condition.md): else-if condition that duplicates the previous arm's
- [suspicious-exit-in-library](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-exit-in-library.md): exit referenced in library code
- [suspicious-failwith-in-library](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-failwith-in-library.md): failwith referenced in library code
- [suspicious-file-exists-race](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-file-exists-race.md): exists check guarding a filesystem operation on the same path
- [suspicious-general-float-equality](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-general-float-equality.md): bit-exact equality on floats
- [suspicious-if-same-branches](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-if-same-branches.md): if whose two branches are written identically
- [suspicious-ignored-partial-application](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-ignored-partial-application.md): ignore of a value that is still a function
- [suspicious-literal-condition](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-literal-condition.md): if over a literal true or false condition
- [suspicious-lost-backtrace](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-lost-backtrace.md): work between catching and re-raising can overwrite the backtrace
- [suspicious-physical-equality](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-physical-equality.md): physical comparison with a non-immediate operand
- [suspicious-polymorphic-compare-on-opaque](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-polymorphic-compare-on-opaque.md): polymorphic comparison of a Set, Map, or Hashtbl value
- [suspicious-print-debugging](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-print-debugging.md): console printing entrypoint referenced in library code
- [suspicious-rec-without-recursion](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-rec-without-recursion.md): let rec group that never recurses
- [suspicious-sequence-ignored-value](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-sequence-ignored-value.md): pure projection discarded where the compiler cannot warn
- [suspicious-str-formatter](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-str-formatter.md): reference to the process-global Format.str_formatter
- [suspicious-swallowed-cancellation](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-swallowed-cancellation.md): total handler around eio code converts cancellation into a value
- [suspicious-transposable-arguments](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-transposable-arguments.md): three adjacent same-typed unlabeled parameters
- [suspicious-unused-module-binding](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-unused-module-binding.md): module binding the unit never uses and never exports
- [suspicious-variant-arity-tuple](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-variant-arity-tuple.md): constructor whose one argument is a parenthesized tuple
- [suspicious-wall-clock-elapsed](pages/reference/rules/suspicious-wall-clock-elapsed.md): duration computed from wall-clock reads
- [trailing-whitespace](pages/reference/rules/trailing-whitespace.md): trailing spaces or tabs at end of line
- [unsafe-obj-magic](pages/reference/rules/unsafe-obj-magic.md): use of Obj.magic
- [unsafe-partial-stdlib](pages/reference/rules/unsafe-partial-stdlib.md): reference to a partial stdlib eliminator
- [untyped-ignore](pages/reference/rules/untyped-ignore.md): ignore discards a value without naming its type
- [untyped-wildcard-binding](pages/reference/rules/untyped-wildcard-binding.md): let _ discards a value without naming its type
- [unused-export](pages/reference/rules/unused-export.md): exported value never used by another unit
- [used-underscore-binding](pages/reference/rules/used-underscore-binding.md): underscore-prefixed binding is used
- [wildcard-over-owned-variant](pages/reference/rules/wildcard-over-owned-variant.md): a wildcard arm in a match over a variant the code owns
